sources.authority: Each client city, county or special district (legislative body named per client)

sources.planned_filter: OData v3: $filter=substringof('eminent domain',MatterTitle) or substringof('condemnation',MatterTitle)  (also try 'right-of-way', 'acquisition', 'necessity', 'easement'); add  and MatterIntroDate ge datetime'2026-01-01'  and $orderby=MatterIntroDate desc. A matter that is introduced/on an agenda but has no MatterPassedDate is the earliest signal.

sources.notes: Every client below was tested on 2026-11-17 with a real request to /matters (latest matter) and a title search for 'eminent domain'/'condemnation'. No key needed for these clients. Max 1000 rows per request ($top/$skip). Other useful endpoints: /bodies, /events?$filter=EventDate ge datetime'..', /events/{id}/eventitems, /matters/{id}/attachments (PDF links), /matters/{id}/texts/{textId} (full text), /matters/{id}/histories. Place names are in the free text only - no geometry. 'active': false means the client answers but its newest matter is old (city left Legistar or stopped publishing). Not usable without a token: nyc and phila (HTTP 403, token required). Not on Legistar API (HTTP 500 'not set up'): Houston, Chicago (own eLMS API, see separate source), Los Angeles city, San Diego city, Indianapolis, Atlanta (current), Tucson, Las Vegas, Memphis, Omaha, Raleigh, Tampa, Tulsa, Honolulu among others tested.
